peircean_analysis.firstness: Four manual forensic review artifacts, all prior_trust 0.10-0.15, spoofability 0.85-0.90. Testigo-A: downloaded 10GB of defendant material, claims not to know defendant, linked to complainant's brother. Brother: downloaded defendant material, defendant has had him blocked for years (real-time monitoring physically impossible), could not produce screenshots, does not know his own phone number, declared quantity=null. Mother: declares defendant dangerous and interfering with complainant's sister — defendant has never met the sister. Structural meta: all three witnesses linked to complainant, zero independent witnesses, testimonies converge on danger narrative without verified contact.
peircean_analysis.secondness: Legitimate witness testimony is independent by definition — witnesses do not share a common interest or organizational link. Against this baseline: (A) Testigo-A downloaded 10GB about a person she claims not to know. Legitimate strangers do not routinely bulk-download material about people they have no relationship with — the download quantity directly contradicts the claimed ignorance. (B) The brother's surveillance claim requires access to content from someone who has him actively blocked. A blocked contact cannot view the blocking party's content or receive their communications — this is a structural impossibility, not a memory gap. (C) The mother asserts facts about a relationship (defendant interfering with sister) that forensic record shows does not exist — this is not misrecollection but assertion of an unverifiable fictional interaction. (D) Zero independent witnesses among three is not a statistical anomaly — it is the defining structural signature of coordinated testimony.
peircean_analysis.thirdness: Carnegie Social Proof: three voices nominally 'independent' converge on the same danger characterization to manufacture consensus. The convergence is not independent — all three share the complainant as the organizing social node. The three Grice maxim violations identify the coordination mechanism: Quantity (brother conceals download quantity while peripheral knows exact figure), Quality (mother asserts non-existent relationship facts), Relation (Testigo-A's fear declaration is irrelevant to any verified interaction with defendant). Testimony constructed to serve a narrative produces exactly this pattern: each witness contributes the element the narrative requires, not what they personally witnessed.

refutation_protocol.benign_hypothesis: H1: Witnesses sharing a social circle with the complainant may independently have observed concerning behavior. 10GB download by Testigo-A could reflect genuine research born of real concern. The brother's memory failures could be explained by stress.
refutation_protocol.test_result: H1 REFUTED: (A) Testigo-A downloaded 10GB about someone she claims not to know — these are mutually exclusive states (ignorance and bulk research cannot coexist). (B) The brother's surveillance claim requires a technically impossible channel (blocked contact cannot monitor in real time) — this is not a memory failure, it is a physical impossibility. (C) The mother asserts facts about a non-existent relationship — this is not misrecollection, it is assertion of fiction. (D) Zero independent witnesses among three is not coincidence — it is the structural signature of a single-node network.
refutation_protocol.refutation_outcome: H1 REFUTED on four independent prongs. H2 consistent with all observed structural anomalies. Verdict: NOISE for accusations, SUSPICION for testimony coordination.

devil_advocate: Witnesses sharing a social network with the complainant does not automatically invalidate their testimony. The 10GB download by Testigo-A could represent genuine concern-driven research by a connected party. Social proof effects can cause convergent testimony without explicit coordination. Counter: the technical impossibility of the brother's surveillance claim establishes that at least one core testimony element is factually false — not merely unverifiable. One confirmed impossibility within a testimony network shifts the entire network from 'possibly honest' to 'requires corroboration'.
